---

I am currently a PhD student in the Graduate Schools for Law and Politics at The University of Tokyo.

My research focuses on political generations as a long-term political process. I am particularly interested in how political generations are shaped by contemporary politics and society, and how they, in turn, shape political and social dynamics. While my primary focus is on Japan, I also conduct comparative research on other advanced democracies.
